score_function: score; imported for numeric scoring only; TEST audit wrapper must report actual TEST_accessed=true
Q: sqrt(sum(error**2)/number_of_transition_starts), SI meters, per scene before scene-equal macro means

acceptance.safety_integrity_actuators: retain existing checks; no added attitude-improvement gate

reports: all six methods and all 48 scenes
each W00-W15 and preregistered frequency bands
safety stops, saturation, clipping and completeness
timing mean,p50,p95,p99,max,over1ms per scene,ready/nonready; retain JIT samples

bootstrap.unit: one paired physical scene, never within-flight windows
bootstrap.group_sampling: within each declared group, replacement, common sample indices across methods
bootstrap.interval: numpy quantile 0.025 and 0.975 of scene-equal mean paired Q differences; default linear interpolation
bootstrap.scope: descriptive intervals for fixed simulation design; no multiplicity-corrected significance or cross-training-seed claims
